responsibility: This machine-description file defines the eBPF RTL patterns that map GCC’s middle-end operations onto concrete BPF instructions and assembler syntax. It declares unspecs, attributes, mode iterators, and the instruction patterns for arithmetic, shifts, byte swapping, conditional and unconditional jumps, calls, prologue/epilogue expansion hooks, special packet-load operations like ldabs/ldind, and atomic xadd, including ISA-conditioned variants such as alu32, jmp32, and xBPF signed divide/mod operations; it is the core instruction-selection specification for the target.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-stem BPF files, this machine-description file is the declarative RTL pattern source that maps GCC operations onto concrete BPF insns such as arithmetic, branches, calls, packet loads, and xadd. The sibling files instead provide C/C++ target code and hooks (bpf.cc), preprocessor/ABI/register macros (bpf.h), or target option specifications (bpf.opt).
